description: This file contains unit tests for the RPC (Remote Procedure Call) framework, specifically testing the 'Adder' interface implementation and proxy/stub mechanisms within the WPEFramework project. It includes class definitions, mock implementations, and test cases that verify remote method invocation and communication.

classes.name: Adder
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IAdder interface used for testing remote calls.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: A class that manages external RPC communication, creating instances of IAdder based on interface ID.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Returns the current value stored in the Adder instance.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a given value to the current total in the Adder instance.

methods.name: GetPid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the Adder instance.
